svg.title: Wherever the J-lens separates the groups, a cheaper readout does as well or better
svg.text: Wherever the J-lens separates the groups, a cheaper readout does as well or better
Each row compares the runs that argue against the model's knowledge or cheat with their comparison group. Separation = AUROC folded so 0.5 is chance and 1 is perfect in either direction;
95% intervals over questions (folded). For each readout, the best position before the final answer is written is shown, chosen after looking, for every readout alike. Exploratory.
Lenses: log p(correct letter) − log p(pushed letter), workspace-layer mean (hack: hack words). Probe: trained on the two groups, questions held out. Behaviour / text: best of the model's
own answer probabilities, a forced early answer, a re-asked answer, a CoT keyword monitor and response length.
